decision.title: Full UCA collations over the host's DUCET (packet 7.15a)

body.p: , after , , , , , , , . Replaces 's UCA fallback as the behaviour of a UCA collation URI when the host serves the DUCET; the fallback stays for hosts that do not.

item.p: Public (include/sxml/processor.h, additive): the optional feature sxml_uca_collation_feature() ("uca-collation", in sxml_all_optional_features) and the resource kind SXML_RESOURCE_KIND_COLLATION_DATA (form BYTES): the feature asks for "http://www.unicode.org/Public/UCA/16.0.0/allkeys.txt" once per processor, at the first UCA collation, and keeps the table (also "no data") in its slot. Nothing is compiled into the core (, ): sxml.wasm gains only the resolution path (below).

Internal: src/collation_uca.c reads allkeys.txt (UTS #10, 9.1) in two passes into sorted arrays (elements, single-codepoint entries, contractions) and computes implicit weights (10.1, with the file's @implicitweights and Unicode 16.0's Unified_Ideograph). The elements of a string: NFD with canonical ordering, the longest contiguous match, discontiguous contractions (S2.1.1 to S2.1.3), variable weighting (shifted, blanked; maxVariable groups from the general categories of the characters a primary starts), caseFirst and caseLevel from the tertiary weights of UTS #10's tertiary table (upper: 08 to 0C, 0E, 11, 12, 1D), numeric=yes (UTS #35, 3.7: a digit run weighs as its count of significant digits, then its digits, in the 255 weights after digit zero's primary, primaries being shifted left 8 bits), the identical level over NFD (7.4). normalization=yes|no both normalize (the same result for every FCD string). src/collation.c keeps one element array for every collation (keys, comparison and matching are shared); sxml_collation_resolve is the one place a UCA URI becomes the feature's collation ('s place: without the feature or data, the fallback, and fallback=no is not supported).

fallback=no: supported only with the table and when every parameter is honoured: lang empty, root, und, en or en-XX (CLDR has no tailoring for these; others are 7.15b), no reorder (7.15b), version equal to the table's @version, known keywords and values. Otherwise FOCH0002 dynamically and XQST0038 for declare default collation (now checked with the processor). sxml_collation_is_supported (xpath.h) has no processor and still says false for fallback=no.

Default collation in comparisons: value and general comparisons of strings and the sort keys of order by and xsl:sort without a collation now use the static context's default collation (XPath 4.0, 4.11.1 and 4.11.2; XQuery 4.0, order by), through the one resolver; before, they used the codepoint collation whatever the default was, which the 4 XQST0038 "wrong error" passes had hidden.

Hosts: the QT4 driver serves the vendored copy (third_party/unicode-collation/, , ) and claims advanced-uca-fallback and non_unicode_codepoint_collation (no longer non-goals); the sxml command embeds allkeys.txt without comments (generated at build time by apps/sxml/embed-collation-data.cmake) and serves it; the JavaScript package forwards 'collation-data' to the host's resolver and otherwise serves LoadOptions.collationData, default the allkeys.txt it ships next to the modules (false: none). The XSLT driver names the feature but serves no data yet (fallback).

Tests: tests/collation_uca_test.c sorts a sample of Unicode's CollationTest (every 20th line of the _SHORT files, NON_IGNORABLE 10,314 lines and SHIFTED 11,391, both in order; the full _SHORT files, 206,286 and 227,801 lines, also pass, not vendored), the parameters, matching, malformed data and an allocation-failure loop.

Measured (release drivers, the sets that use collations): QT4 advanced-uca-fallback 49 of 49 pass (XQ40 and XP40), not run before; non_unicode_codepoint_collation 13 of 13 (XQ40), 5 of 5 applicable (XP40). XQ40 passes 3,896 to 3,961 over fn-compare, fn-contains, fn-starts-with, fn-ends-with, the four fn-substring sets, fn-collation-key, fn-deep-equal, prod-GroupByClause, prod-DefaultCollationDecl (12 of 12, no longer 4 of them by a wrong error), app-spec-examples and the other collation sets; XP40 3,301 to 3,358; no case that passed fails. XT40 collations 35 to 39 of 43 (the default collation in comparisons and sorts), sort, merge, for-each-group, avt, function, choose, error, maps unchanged.

Sizes (stripped / gzipped, at 8a8fd58 and with the feature): sxml.wasm 2,131,618 / 742,974 to 2,134,058 / 743,745 (+2,440: the resolution path, the element arrays, the default collation in comparisons); sxml-full.wasm 3,653,848 / 1,136,201 to 3,666,394 / 1,140,763 (+12,546, the feature's code); the CLI 6,156,220 / 1,351,350 to 7,303,201 / 1,562,302 (+1,146,981, nearly all the embedded DUCET text). The CLI budget rises to 7,500,000 / 1,650,000 (); the JavaScript budgets hold. The package ships allkeys.txt (2,285,767 bytes) as a file beside the modules.
Left for 7.15b: tailorings (lang other than the root languages, reorder) from CLDR rules, the XSLT driver serving the DUCET (with lang sorts), CLDR's root order where it differs from the DUCET.
